receivedReports.summary: Confirmed official name Åkulla - Ästad, N7, Norra delleden, Varberg/Halland, official distance 12 km and Blue/medium difficulty. Flagged official topology ambiguity: previous/next in northern track are Nösslinge-Åkulla and Varberg-Åkulla, while Ästad also relates to cross-track continuation. Confirmed GPX/API geo_json 223-point 12.236 km line from Åkulla Outdoor Resort to Byasjön shelter, conflicting API line.geometry ending near Ästad village/4H/Vingård. Noted stale English shelter text and GPX filename Mellersta_Akulla_Astad despite Norra delleden classification.

Official GPX-proximity pass identified high-confidence import candidates: Lägerplats Åkulla, Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort, Åkulla Outdoor Resort, seasonal Lägerplats Yasjön, Lägerplats Byasjön/Vindskydd Ästad, Skärbäcks gård, Öströö Fårfarm, Bexells talande stenar, and Toppbjärs reservat. Kept Ästad Vingård, Ästad 4H, Långanskogen/Emmas stuga and parking as access/endpoint metadata pending geometry decision; suppressed Björkasjö and other far side-trip records.

Found direct current N7 field-report coverage thin. Direct reports are old/pre-2024, including En Vandringssaga 2019 reverse Ästad-Åkulla and Utsidan 2005. Recent adjacent-route reports around Ästad, Byasjön, Öströö, Kalvsjön and Åkulla Bokskogar generally show good conditions, easy/gravel/road-heavy walking, livestock/electric-fence caveats, and possible wetness near lake/boardwalk areas. No independent post-2024 confirmation of the Kalvsjön reroute was found.

Confirmed Åkulla Bokskogar as a reserve landscape/cluster, with high-confidence rule impacts at Åkullaboket, Toppbjär and Långanskogen; Skärbäck, Skogsbo and Valaklitt need overlay before being treated as crossed. Key rules include dogs leashed in reserves, fire only at designated places in several reserves, Yasjön island closed 1 March-30 June and raft 1 July-mid-October, Byasjön water unconfirmed, and dynamic fire-ban checks via current official sources. Reroute page confirms 2024 Kalvsjön reroute and stale June 2022 paper maps.

Recommended official Hallandsleden GPX/API geo_json as canonical N7 geometry and not API line.geometry, OSM, or route-app distances. Confirmed GPX/API geo_json is a 223-point 12.236 km LineString from Åkulla Outdoor Resort to Byasjön shelter, N6-to-N7 continuity 0.6 m, N7-to-M7 continuity 0.2 m, and start-to-M1 continuity 5.8 m. Naturkartan site 19215 geometry now matches current GPX endpoints/distance but metadata still says 13.0 km/red; OSM relation 7398315 remains stale with old endpoints and 13.373 km. Kalvsjön reroute page updated 2024-11-07 confirms the current line west of Kalvsjön.

Confirmed closest start commute point Åkulla (Varberg kn), ResRobot extId 740074382, 57.124012/12.566353, about 0.21 km from GPX start, seasonal Åkturen. Confirmed closest named end stop Ästad (Varberg kn), extId 740023695, 57.063847/12.560456, about 1.87 km straight-line from the official GPX end at Byasjön but about 0.21 km from Ästad Vingård, so endpoint access needs a connector/walk caveat. Noted 2026 Åkturen season 15 June-16 August from Hallandstrafiken news, possible line 660 regular access, Brännhult/Haksered fallbacks for Åkulla broader access, and that Byasjön shelter parking is unsuitable with Skogsbo/Skärbäck as general parking alternatives.
